description: This line plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" across four different model and dataset combinations. The x-axis lacks an explicit title and displays a discrete scale with tick marks at the values 128, 256, 512, and 1024, which are spaced equally apart despite representing a doubling progression. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. Four solid lines represent the data. The blue line, marked with circles, represents "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep"; it begins at approximately 0.20 at x=128, rises to roughly 0.35 at x=512, and ends with a slight increase to approximately 0.36 at x=1024. The orange line, marked with squares, represents "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep"; it starts at roughly 0.15 at x=128, increases to approximately 0.42 at x=512, and remains steady, ending at the same value of 0.42 at x=1024. The green line, marked with upward-pointing triangles, represents "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench"; it begins at the lowest point on the graph of approximately 0.06 at x=128, climbs to roughly 0.37 at x=512, and ends at approximately 0.38 at x=1024. Finally, the red line, marked with diamonds, represents "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench"; it starts at approximately 0.24 at x=128, increases to roughly 0.42 at x=512, and continues to rise to the highest point on the graph of approximately 0.51 at x=1024.
